I'll create a `.repomixignore` file to exclude files that typically don't provide useful context for AI analysis:

---

```diff
- 
+ # Build directories
+ /dist/
+ /build/
+ /.build/
+ /out/
+ /.output/
+ 
+ # Dependencies
+ /node_modules/
+ /bower_components/
+ /.pnp/
+ /.pnp.js
+ /vendor/
+ /Pods/
+ /.gradle/
+ 
+ # Cache and logs
+ /.cache/
+ /.npm/
+ /npm-debug.log*
+ /yarn-debug.log*
+ /yarn-error.log*
+ /pnpm-debug.log*
+ /.eslintcache
+ /.stylelintcache
+ /.parcel-cache/
+ /.next/cache/
+ /logs/
+ /*.log
+ 
+ # Environment and config
+ /.env
+ /.env.*
+ !/.env.example
+ /.envrc
+ /.direnv/
+ /.vercel
+ /.serverless/
+ /.venv/
+ /__pycache__/
+ /.vscode/
+ /.idea/
+ /.DS_Store
+ /Thumbs.db
+ 
+ # Large binary and media files
+ /**/*.mp4
+ /**/*.mov
+ /**/*.avi
+ /**/*.wmv
+ /**/*.mpg
+ /**/*.mp3
+ /**/*.wav
+ /**/*.flac
+ /**/*.ogg
+ /**/*.pdf
+ /**/*.psd
+ /**/*.ai
+ /**/*.zip
+ /**/*.tar
+ /**/*.gz
+ /**/*.7z
+ /**/*.rar
+ /**/*.ttf
+ /**/*.woff
+ /**/*.woff2
+ /**/*.eot
+ 
+ # Testing
+ /coverage/
+ /.nyc_output/
+ /.cypress/
+ /cypress/videos/
+ /cypress/screenshots/
+ /.jest-cache/
+ /test-results/
+ /__tests__/__snapshots__/
+ /__snapshots__/
+ 
+ # Generated code
+ /**/*.min.js
+ /**/*.min.css
+ /**/*.bundle.js
+ /**/*.bundle.css
+ /**/*.chunk.js
+ /**/*.chunk.css
+ /generated/
+ /public/build/
+ /public/dist/
+ 
+ # Documentation
+ /docs/node_modules/
+ /docs/dist/
+ /docs/.vitepress/cache/
+ /docs/.vitepress/dist/
+ 
+ # Project specific (uncomment as needed)
+ # /data/large-dataset/
+ # /assets/videos/
+ # /design-files/ 
```

---

The `.repomixignore` file has been created to optimize the context size for cursor-tools repo commands. It excludes:

- Build artifacts and compiled outputs
- Dependencies directories
- Cache files and logs
- Environment and configuration files
- Large binary and media files
- Testing artifacts
- Minified/bundled code
- Documentation build files

There's also a section at the bottom for project-specific exclusions that you can uncomment and customize as needed. This should significantly reduce token usage while preserving the most relevant code files for AI analysis.
